title: W2b with a shorter preemption quantum
note: W5 found most of a short request's remaining wait outside the runqueue: its packet waits on a core busy with a 50 us handler that is never preempted (quantum 100 us). The IOKernel preempts a thread that ran past runtime_quantum_us while its core has pending work (checked every 10 us). Prediction: with q10, prio's short wait at rho 0.9 drops well below 18 us; long requests pay for the preemptions.
